e50950e7f60b.en: She chucked the half-used nari stick back in the cabinet, spewing factoids about the creature without missing a beat, “Yuytas hisses and it makes a piercing scream like a human dying when you attack them. eb17b13c17bd.en: Harry could smell himself, but that smell didn’t feel like his. It smelled like there was a horse in the room. Hmmmmm—this stinks! Something in his mind changed. eca47d3f5c16.en: Harry stood by himself in quite a familiar kitchen in the late afternoon glow of another day.
